initial_prompts.character:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: One character reference image for the pixel-art Godot game Last on Board. This is an original new protagonist concept, one full-body character in one pose, no turnaround or collage.
Primary request: An adult ammunition technician who climbs a runaway weather-control tower to repair it. Capture the expressive, bold-cluster pixel-art sensibility of SANABI and the user references described here: adult body with readable long limbs, asymmetric practical equipment, very few large shadow planes, selectively lit edges. Original character design.
Subject: A lean, weathered adult with short tousled dark hair, one simple warm face plane and determined expression, wearing a dark blue-green thigh-length work coat with a split hem, rolled repair sleeves, muted ochre neck cloth, charcoal trousers and heavy worn boots. One bulky rectangular ammunition tool case high on the back and three large copper cartridge shapes at the belt communicate the occupation. A compact industrial long gun held low in both hands pointing right, visibly separate from the coat; a hand-fed rectangular breech, solid barrel, wood-brown grip. Equipment should feel repaired and useful, not ornamental armor. Two hands and two legs clearly readable. Approximately six-head adult proportions, grounded balanced stance, feet planted at different horizontal positions.
Style/medium: True deliberately coarse hand-placed pixel art. Draw as if on a low-resolution 128 x 128 logical canvas and show it cleanly enlarged by nearest-neighbor on a square reference image; the character should be about 95 logical pixels tall. CONSISTENT visible square pixels, confident stair-stepped contours, connected big flat pixel clusters. About 16 restrained colors total, 2 to 3 value steps per material. No subpixel detail, no smooth painted shading, no photographic texture, no excessive tiny highlights. Pixel structure is the core requirement.
Composition: single full body centered, right-facing three-quarter side view suitable for a side-view game. Leave breathing room around entire silhouette and muzzle. Plain flat desaturated blue-grey background, one restrained pixelated contact shadow immediately beneath the boots. No scene, no second character, no small duplicate.
Lighting: quiet cool light from upper right and only a few warm copper accents. Clear coat/arms/trousers/gun value separation.
Avoid: chibi, giant head, mascot, cowboy hat, copied SANABI character or mechanical chain arm, excessive rivets, chrome reflection noise, anatomy rendered as smooth high-resolution concept art, text, labels, borders, logos, watermarks, UI.
initial_prompts.background:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: One wide landscape background reference image for the 2D side-view pixel-art Godot game Last on Board. Original environment concept, not a screenshot or UI mockup.
Primary request: A strongly dystopian inhabited ruin inside a colossal runaway weather-control tower. At the bottom, a continuous horizontal maintenance platform overlooks a deep vertical residential and industrial canyon. Architecture towers far out of the top of frame; civilization and scale feel oppressive. A small surviving repair refuge at the far left retains a trace of human warmth.
Style/medium: Authentic deliberately drawn pixel art, with the bold geometric architectural clusters and depth of SANABI. Treat the whole wide scene as approximately a 480 x 270 logical pixel painting cleanly enlarged by nearest-neighbor. Consistent square pixel grid, crisp stair-stepped edges, connected broad flat color shapes, restrained 24-color palette. Every surface and light uses discrete flat color steps; no painterly blur, no smooth gradients, no photographic grain, no fine noisy texture. This must unmistakably read as a sophisticated pixel-art game environment at first glance.
Composition: Wide 16:9 landscape, side-on combat stage. Continuous horizontal dark steel walking surface across the bottom at about 80 percent image height, with clearly visible solid thickness and support structure below. Preserve open standing space above the platform through the central 70 percent. Four depth layers: near-black edge pillars and hanging cables at outer edges; a muted middle-distance shuttered residential passage and thick utility pipes; immense repetitive tower facades and high inaccessible connecting bridges; distant pale grey-green atmospheric void. Strong vertical structures above a usable horizontal stage. A broad darker midground wall behind the lower middle separates future characters from the city detail. No vanishing road or walkway disappearing into the screen.
Scene: huge vertical elevator shafts, sealed shutters, water conduits, broken high gantries and a few drooping heavy cables. Use repetitions sparingly with large quiet surfaces, avoid filling every square with windows. At far left under a modest awning: one small amber-lit repair-shop window, a kettle silhouette, a pair of empty crates and drying cloth hint at survivors without depicting people. The warm corner is a small area under 10 percent of the frame. A few tiny dim warning lamps higher up. Architecture feels massive and abandoned but still partly working.
Color and lighting: dark ink navy foreground, desaturated petrol/grey-green midground, lighter smoky teal distant city, a small amount of muted mauve depth, sparse amber light. Strong readable value separation across depth planes; darkness without turning everything into black. Foreground strongest contrast, background lower contrast. Light and haze are flat pixel clusters with discrete edges.
Constraints: no characters, monsters, weapons, UI, cards, words, lettering, digits, logos, watermarks, cinematic blur, bloom, scanlines, generic neon cyberpunk signs, dense salt-and-pepper dithering. Keep the source style low-resolution pixel art instead of an illustration with a pixel filter.

style_revision_prompts.character: Use case: style-transfer. Input image 1 is the original character concept to REDRAW; images 2 and 3 are the user's style reference images, NOT characters to copy. Make one corrected character reference image. Preserve ONLY image 1's character identity, adult proportion, right-facing stance, blue-green repair coat, ochre neck cloth, ammo backpack, cartridges and practical long gun. Radically simplify the pixel rendering to the very LOW RESOLUTION style of images 2 and 3. The whole body should have the visual information of roughly 75 to 90 pixels in height, enlarged with large perfectly crisp square pixels. This is the crucial edit: connected large flat pixel clusters and silhouette rather than miniature concept-art shading. Face is just a few flat pixels, no rendered facial anatomy. Hair one dark shape and one highlight cluster. Each coat limb at most 3 flat colors, keep the large coat area largely uninterrupted. Simplify gun to stock, box breech, barrel, preserve two readable hands. Delete tiny folds, stitching, scratches, small specular outlines, rivets and micro-noise. Restrained approximately 14-color sprite palette. Selective stepped dark outer contour; long separated legs and clearly grounded heavy boots. ONE centered full-body figure with modest margin, roughly six-head adult proportion, normal-sized head. Put it on a flat solid muted grey-blue background with a tiny hard-edged contact shadow under feet. The crisp chunky pixels should be as immediately visible as the adult in input image 2. No smooth transitions, no antialiasing, no texture overlay, no realistic face, no high-definition gun mechanics, no additional figures, no panels, no text, no labels, no logos. Do not merely apply a pixel filter: fully reconstruct the figure as sparse low-resolution sprite shapes.
style_revision_prompts.background: Use case: style-transfer. Input image 1 is the environment concept to REDRAW, inputs 2 and 3 are user's architectural pixel-art style references. Preserve image 1's composition: wide dystopian tower canyon, uninterrupted side-on bottom platform, tiny warm repair refuge on far left, massive towers extending past top, high bridges and deep vertical void. Change the rendering to the visibly coarser, broad flat PIXEL CLUSTER style of input images 2 and 3. Reconstruct as a disciplined low-resolution 320 x 180 pixel scene enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Large perfectly square visible pixels, all edges stepped on one uniform grid, no smooth gradient or subtle shading between pixel clusters. Reduce the current surface detail by 80 percent: remove brick speckles, tiny facade ridges, rivets and pipe highlights. Tower faces are huge unbroken muted teal rectangles with only a few bold dark structural divisions; window groups simple spaced blocks. Cables are crisp broad staircase arcs. Build depth with four distinct flat tonal planes as clearly as input image 3; retain input image 2's grey-green color feeling. Near-black edge pillars and platform, dark blue-green midground, dusty teal distant towers, pale green deep atmosphere. Only several warm amber pixels at the left refuge and 2 or 3 distant warning lights. Constrain total visual palette to around 20 colors. Keep atmosphere strong through composition and values, with no painterly haze. Lower central area quiet for future character silhouettes; platform is an actual grounded solid walking surface across entire width. ONE wide 16:9 reference image. No characters, UI, words, numbers, labels, watermarks, photo texture, bloom, dithering, illustration brushwork. Do not retain the high-resolution painting details of input image 1.

Fix the arm/hand anatomy with a simpler unambiguous pose: exactly TWO ARMS and exactly TWO HANDS total. The near arm bends upward with its ONE visible hand resting on the backpack chest strap at upper chest height. The far arm drops down to the hip with its ONE visible hand gripping the gun's pistol grip; the gun hangs diagonally down to the lower right at rest. Gun held ONE-HANDED at its grip, other hand clearly visible far away at chest strap. Keep the gun separate from the coat and completely inside the canvas.
Single centered full body. Pixelated grounded contact shadow under boots. Plain solid muted slate-blue background; no texture. Keep very coarse deliberately sparse pixel clusters: face only several flat blocks, no realistic shading, no added details, no antialiasing. No text, captions, extra figures, panels, borders, logos.
